title: Get Lift Agency
intro: GET LIFT is a full-service B2B marketing agency based in Toronto. Following a rebrand, they wanted a completely new website on HubSpot CMS, and I was brought in as the Front End Developer to build it from scratch.
outro: HubSpot was a new platform for me. Unlike most CMSs, it has its own HTML drag-and-drop builder, which made building the page skeleton fast. I used Sass as a preprocessor, as I always do, to keep the styles manageable across more than 12 different template designs.

alts.03-creative.jpg: Get Lift creative services page with a grid of campaign case studies
alts.04-lead-scoring.jpg: Get Lift lead scoring service page

title: Business Email Newsletter
intro: A bold, flat-design email template created for the HubSpot Marketplace.
outro: On the design side, I experimented with a richer colour palette to give the template a polished, corporate look and feel.

alts.01-desktop.jpg: Business email newsletter template for the HubSpot Marketplace, shown on desktop in a flat design with a bold colour palette
alts.02-phone.jpg: The same business newsletter template on a phone, in a single-column layout

title: Get Lift Channels Landing Page
intro: GET LIFT Agency asked me to build the landing page for their new Channels Program campaign. The challenge was matching the approved mockup exactly: I built the form in HubSpot and used the browser inspector to override its default styling.
outro: The campaign was a success, generating leads for the agency's new customers on both desktop and mobile.

alts.01-desktop.jpg: Get Lift Channels Program landing page on desktop, with a HubSpot sign-up form
alts.02-mobile.jpg: Get Lift Channels Program landing page on a phone

title: The Marketing Science International Inc
intro: Marketing Science International Inc. is a marketing automation training and services provider for Eloqua clients. They also offer creative and development services for clients including Lutron, Dufferin Iron & Railings and Kanata Rims and Tires.
outro: I delivered this project end to end, from the logo design to the full site interface. The site runs on WordPress with a custom theme and editable pages, so the client can manage their own content.

alts.02-portfolio.jpg: Marketing Science International portfolio page showing client work

title: Get Lift Evolve
intro: GET LIFT Agency was attending the 2017 SiriusDecisions Summit and needed a landing page to promote their partnership with SiriusDecisions.
outro: This was one of the first landing page templates I built from scratch in the HubSpot code editor instead of the drag-and-drop COS editor. I chose a flexbox layout over HubSpot's 12-column float grid because it gave me better control over the design.

alts.01-desktop.jpg: Get Lift Evolve landing page for the 2017 SiriusDecisions Summit, on desktop
alts.02-mobile.png: Get Lift Evolve landing page on a phone

title: Lutron Greetings
intro: Marketing Science International Inc. asked me to produce a holiday greeting campaign for their client Lutron, made up of an animation, a landing page and an email. The client supplied the assets and storyboard, so my role was assembling them and animating the piece in After Effects.
outro: The campaign was built in Eloqua. Once the animation was approved, the email was straightforward: a thumbnail linking through to the landing page.

alts.01-design.jpg: Lutron holiday greeting campaign design with the animation, landing page and email layouts
alts.02-greeting.jpg: Lutron holiday greeting email with a thumbnail linking to the animated landing page

title: Dark Theme Email Template
intro: My second email template for the HubSpot Marketplace, designed in Photoshop and hand-coded from scratch.
outro: A recurring challenge with templates is letting clients swap images and text without breaking the code, which is a common cause of rendering issues in Outlook. I commented the code thoroughly so users with limited HTML knowledge can safely edit or remove sections on their own.

alts.03-light-desktop.jpg: Light theme version of the email template on desktop
alts.04-light-mobile.png: Light theme version of the email template on a phone

title: Season Greeting Newsletter
intro: A responsive, single-column email built to render reliably across all email clients, including those that don't support responsive design.
outro: The hero section was the hardest part. In the responsive version, the static desktop image is replaced with a looping GIF animation of the particles.
